mapper.sql: a.achievement_id AS "achievementId", a.management_no AS "managementNo", a.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", u.login_id AS "teacherName", u.employee_no AS "employeeNo", a.organization_code AS "organizationCode", a.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", a.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", a.achievement_date AS "achievementDate", a.achievement_name AS "achievementName", a.achievement_detail::text AS "achievementDetail", a.achievement_status AS "achievementStatus", a.attachment_ref AS "attachmentRef"
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_achievements a JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id

SELECT FROM education_achievements a JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
AND a.achievement_id = #{achievementId}

SELECT FROM education_achievements a JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
AND a.achievement_id = #{achievementId} FOR UPDATE OF a

SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND CURRENT_DATE >= m.effective_start_date AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR CURRENT_DATE <= m.effective_end_date) ORDER BY m.mapping_id LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT s.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", s.management_item_name AS "managementItemName", s.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", s.teacher_editable_part AS "teacherEditablePart" FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings s JOIN organization_user_mappings m ON m.organization_code = s.target_scope WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND s.item_code = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND s.evaluation_confirmed_yn = 'N' ORDER BY s.evaluation_year DESC, s.management_item_code

SELECT s.teacher_editable_part AS "teacherEditablePart" FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings s WHERE s.management_item_code = #{managementItemCode} AND s.evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} AND s.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND s.evaluation_confirmed_yn = 'N' AND s.target_scope = #{organizationCode} ORDER BY s.setting_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, achievement_name = #{achievementName}, achievement_detail = CAST(#{achievementDetail} AS jsonb), attachment_ref = #{attachmentRef}, request_id = #{requestId}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, next_status, action_type, processed_by, request_id ) VALUES ('EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT', #{achievementId}, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', #{actorId}, #{requestId})
mapper.select: SELECT j.batch_job_id AS "jobId", j.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", j.action_type AS "actionType", j.requester_user_id AS "requesterUserId", j.job_status AS "jobStatus", j.total_count AS "totalCount", j.processed_count AS "processedCount", j.unprocessed_count AS "unprocessedCount" FROM employment_rate_batch_jobs j WHERE j.batch_job_id = #{jobId}

SELECT i.target_user_id AS "targetUserId", i.processed_yn AS "processedYn", i.unprocessed_reason AS "unprocessedReason" FROM employment_rate_batch_job_items i WHERE i.batch_job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY i.batch_job_item_id
SELECT u.user_id AS "teacherUserId" FROM users u WHERE u.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.system_use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY u.user_id LIMIT 1

SELECT t.template_id AS "templateId", t.template_version AS "templateVersion" FROM excel_upload_templates t WHERE t.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND t.effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY t.effective_date DESC, t.template_version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.required_column FROM excel_upload_template_rules r WHERE r.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY r.column_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO excel_upload_staging_rows ( staging_row_id, upload_id, row_number, row_payload, validation_status ) VALUES (#{rowId}, #{uploadId}, #{rowNumber}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{validationStatus})

INSERT INTO excel_upload_errors ( error_id, upload_id, row_number, column_name, error_code, error_reason, correction_guide ) VALUES (#{errorId}, #{uploadId}, #{rowNumber}, 'row', #{errorCode}, #{errorReason}, '원본 행을 수정하세요.')

INSERT INTO excel_upload_histories ( upload_id, total_count, success_count, error_count, saved_count, processor_user_id ) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{errorCount}, #{savedCount}, #{actorId}) ON CONFLICT (upload_id) DO UPDATE SET saved_count = EXCLUDED.saved_count, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, processor_user_id = EXCLUDED.processor_user_id
mapper.sql: f.upload_id AS "uploadId", f.file_token AS "fileToken", f.uploader_user_id AS "uploaderUserId", f.validation_status AS "validationStatus"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM excel_upload_files f WHERE f.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT FROM excel_upload_files f WHERE f.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.row_number AS "rowNumber", s.row_payload::text AS "payload" FROM excel_upload_staging_rows s WHERE s.upload_id = #{uploadId} ORDER BY s.row_number
SELECT e.row_number AS "rowNumber", e.error_code AS "errorCode", e.error_reason AS "errorReason" FROM excel_upload_errors e WHERE e.upload_id = #{uploadId} ORDER BY e.row_number, e.error_id

SELECT f.upload_id AS "uploadId", f.original_file_name AS "originalFileName", f.uploaded_at AS "uploadedAt", f.validation_status AS "validationStatus", h.total_count AS "totalCount", h.success_count AS "successCount", h.error_count AS "errorCount", h.saved_count AS "savedCount" FROM excel_upload_files f JOIN excel_upload_histories h ON h.upload_id = f.upload_id WHERE f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.uploader_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.uploaded_at DESC, f.upload_id
mapper.update: UPDATE excel_upload_files SET validation_status = 'COMMITTED' WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT'
